name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.45-beta “Paris” (build 49): witness statements and expert reports numbered with their submission.
• A witness statement or expert report filed with a submission cites in the submission's exhibit numbers; exhibits only it cites follow after the submission's own (Statement C-1 … C-40, the witness statement's own C-41 …). LitArbi asks once which document is which and remembers it — also for new versions saved under another name.
• Update Exhibits from Brief reads the submission and every document filed with it; a document that isn't open counts with the citations LitArbi last saw in it.
• Submission ▸ Numbering ▸ Witness Statements and Expert Reports… to see and change which documents belong to a submission, and their order.
• Exhibit types now show in the app's language (German, French); Settings ▸ General has a default document type.
